title: Clearance response
description: The receiving institution's signed clearance decision for a package (§10.2 Step 3, Appendix A.8). A PROCEED_TO_KYC response carries exactly the members the session token embeds, so the institution can later re-verify its own signature from the token (§10.3); reason_codes appear only on the other decisions. The top-level institution_signature is over the canonical response without it. Reference proposal: AFSP v0.1 leaves this format to the Technical Working Group (§18); this schema documents the reference implementation's proposal and is not normative AFSP.
